# Mohammad Khairul Shafiq

> Khairul Shafiq (full name Mohammad Khairul Shafiq bin Mohd Nizam) is a technology advisor and solution lead based in Shah Alam, Malaysia. He handles and advises on IT and AI work: he scopes, architects, oversees delivery, and advises. He has more than ten years in IT, is a Microsoft 365 Global Admin, and is a subject-matter expert in Microsoft 365, Intune and endpoint management, and Entra ID identity. His current role is described generically as Technology Solutioning. His direction is infra-to-AI solution architecture: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), local and private AI, and AI agents, shared in public. He founded and leads TanAir.

This profile describes advisory and solution leadership. Projects listed here are work he leads, oversees, or advises on.
